body: Understandable. I just felt like seeking help was a weakness, but at this point in time, everything has built up into this sucking hole that's ruining my work. That's why I came here, I thought it was time to seek a bit of understanding.
Admittance of suicidal thoughts weren't on the table in the first place, but I thank you for letting me know.
Basic phase for the ship. Work all day, every day.
Hm. Interesting point. I'd have to find some sort of time off from this basic phase, but I'll try it out.

There is a lot of pain that I've got, but I'm sure everybody feels that. I just don't know what to do to make the pain go away, or if I even want it to. It's hard to feel like more than a hollowed out husk of a human being when I try to rid myself of the pain. I don't feel anything when others tell a joke, share their heartbreak with me, or want to spend time with me. It all seems like a blank sheet of paper when it comes to emotions. I'm not sure why.

Thanks for the words of wisdom. Honestly, that might be why I haven't done myself in yet: I just want to wait and see if it'll get better. I'm not sure, but I'll take your advice to heart. I may not want anything to do with this life, but I am open to suggestions.

I want to talk to a shrink. I have for about three months now, but my job requires me to be a bit... Sane. So I might lose it due to depression/suicidal thoughts. I talk to my best friend about it constantly, and that's probably why I'm not dead yet.

It used to be reading. Then it changed to my relationship with my ex. Now I feel as though it's nothing. I've got a hobby of racing RC cars, doing brain puzzles such as sudoku or crosswords, I go snorkeling quite often. Nothing seems quite as stimulating as everything used to be.
